general_feeling_english: I felt happy for contributing to a scientific study, but the glasses were uncomfortable and sometimes caused me pain.
challenges_english: I was subjected to strange looks on public transportation because I think people assumed the device was a camera. It also bothered me slightly when conducting experiments in the laboratory, and I was afraid of contamination risk while working with cell cultures.
act_impact_english: Even in cell culture, the bracelet made me afraid due to contamination risk. Using the microscope with the glasses was very difficult for me. It was also hard to use the glasses with a mask.
beh_adapt_english: I did not change my behavior; I continued with my regular routine.
social_english: Everyone was very curious. Even people I don't usually interact with, such as cafe staff or people in my work environment, came up and asked about it. In classes, the instructors asked what it was out of curiosity. Drivers on public transport or security in the metro examined it in detail to figure out what it was. In the cafeteria, I could tell from students' looks that they were talking about the glasses.
improvements_english: The glasses hurt my ears a lot. The bracelet was very thick, and I constantly felt it on my arm, which bothered me a bit. The necklace was fine and did not give me any problems.
